scientific_integrity: Original 2016 authors credited for the model, period-three region, and linear transient recursion. The distinct contribution is exact hitting statistics and singular conditional phase selection. Infinite assertions are analytically proved; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed half-memory tent map only. Exact finite-time laws require uniform area initial states; universality needs density continuous and positive at the origin. Weak convergence is not total-variation convergence; no claims for neighbouring parameters, singular sources, or absolute historical priority.
title: Fibonacci first-entrance law and singular phase selection in a tent map with memory
